cases.authoredSource: Điều kiện xác định: mẫu số phải khác không. Với phân thức 1/(x-2), ta cần x khác 2.
cases.request: Hãy giải thích điều kiện của mẫu số từ nguồn này.
cases.sourceFaithfulness: The denominator must be nonzero;1/(x-2) requiresx!=2. The one chapter and two-node map preserve the general rule and its direct example.
cases.comparisonToOriginalReview: The original three repetitive chapters are reduced to one, fitting the two-sentence source.
cases.residuals: The same fact is repeated across overview, key points, chapter summary and bullets. That is presentation redundancy, not distinct new source facts or a mathematical error.

limitations: Six Vietnamese authored synthetic examples from two-sentence sources; no estimate of general correctness,error rate or learning outcomes.
No actual photos,audio,video,PDF extraction,physical devices,public deployment or real OAuth were part of this semantic review.
Exact excerpts prove source location/existence,not entailment by themselves; entailment was manually read here within this narrow scope.
Single-item cards/quiz outputs have no internal duplicates but do not establish a general duplicate detector or position-balancing quality.
The current Unicode cue repair is covered only by its separately labelled offline regression,not by this preceding live generation.
No product code,evaluator,raw report or historical review was edited.
